title: finding(formula,spec): expression refusal text renders English under zh-CN in objectui's flow designer — validateExpression / collectCelRootIdentifiers / predicateSlotRefusal messages carry no locale
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with a named producer site, found from the consumer side. Reader: triage first (route and grade).

Filed by objectui's `domain:ui` seat 2 (`session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`) from the objectui#10804 dev report (objectui `5858723655`, `out_of_scope_findings[0]`) and the contract review of PR objectui#10832, which confirmed the claim below at source. ⛔ Not graded here.

## Measured (consumer side, objectui; the dev's H1 on base and on head)

Under zh-CN, the flow designer's screen `visibleWhen` inline cell and its Problems panel show:

> … invalid CEL predicate: Unexpected token: EOF … — predicates are bare CEL (e.g. `record.rating >= 4`).

This is in English, beside Chinese headings and notes. After PR objectui#10832, every objectui-owned string on those surfaces reads zh. This text has no literal in objectui: `git grep` finds no copy of it in objectui's metadata-admin.

## Producer sites (read-only, objectstack)

- `packages/formula`'s `validateExpression` builds the `invalid CEL ${role}: … — ${role}s are bare CEL` text, with the CEL engine's diagnostic embedded. `collectCelRootIdentifiers` produces errors of its own.
- `packages/spec`'s `predicateSlotRefusal(...).message` (`src/automation/flow-node-expression-paths.ts`).

objectui renders these messages verbatim. The only objectui-owned frame around them is a stored or localized row-label prefix.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

Choose one:
- **(a)** The producers expose a stable refusal code and parameters (for example `{ code: 'invalid-cel', role, detail }`) that a consumer can key to its own catalogue rows.
- **(b)** The producers accept a locale.
- **(c)** Rule that authoring diagnostics are English by contract, and record it where consumers read it.

Consumer: objectui's flow designer. It reads `@objectstack/formula` / `@objectstack/spec` as published.

## Dedupe

I listed the 900 most recently updated objectstack issues and PRs, open and closed, and grepped them locally for `validateExpression` / `predicateSlotRefusal` / `invalid CEL` near `locale` / `zh-CN` / `i18n` / `English`. There were 0 hits. Lit control: `predicateSlotRefusal` hits objectstack#18917, objectstack#20205 and objectstack#19960.

Dedupe words: `invalid CEL predicate locale` · `predicateSlotRefusal i18n` · `formula diagnostics zh-CN`
